title: CHILD DEVELOPMENT TEACHER
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Child Development Teacher Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Integrate an understanding of the needs, characteristics, and multiple influences that support optimal development in all areas of development for children from birth to age eight.
Promote partnerships between programs, teachers, families, and communities, applying ethical standards and culturally sensitive professional behavior.
Design, implement, and evaluate developmentally appropriate environments, curriculum and teacher/child interactions, while applying the skills of observation and assessment.
Apply effective guidance and interaction strategies that support a child’s social learning, identity, and self-confidence in an early childhood classroom setting.

notes: Hyphenation line-break artifacts in the PDF text (e.g. 'sen -sitive') were read as single words in the outcomes.
The 16 general education units mentioned are needed for the California Child Development Permit: Teacher level, not for this certificate; they are not recorded as ge_units or a GE pattern.
CH DEV 030 is mentioned in the description only as an addition for teaching in infant programs; it is not a requirement of this certificate and is not placed.

The description says recipients 'may teach in private or public preschool and school-age programs' and mentions the Child Development Permit: Teacher level, but names no explicit job title; careers left empty for reviewer check.
CH DEV 011 (Child, Family, and Community) is required by the catalog but absent from the closed list, recorded as a catalog addition.
Section begins at the top of page 90; the preceding 'WRITING ... 3' line belongs to the prior program.
